questions.markdown: A particular load has to be supplied with average voltage of 5V. Find the value of capacitance and transformer turns ratio in a full wave rectifier with capacitor filter such that the ripple factor should not exceed 1%. Assume 220V rms, 50Hz supply voltage.

For a silicon diode, the reverse saturation current is 40nA at 20$^\circ$C. If the diode is forward biased with 0.7V, determine the i) static resistance at 20$^\circ$C ii) dynamic resistance at 20$^\circ$C.
In a Zener voltage regulator circuit, $V_z=12\,\text{V}$, $R_s=1\,\text{k}\Omega$, $R_L=2\,\text{k}\Omega$, input voltage ranges from 15V to 25V. Find (a) $I_L$ (b) $P_Z(\max)$.

Draw the circuit of RC Coupled amplifier and explain the need for connecting bypass capacitor in RC Coupled amplifier. If three RC Coupled amplifiers are cascaded together with an individual voltage gain of 20dB, find the output voltage of second and third amplifier for an input voltage of 5mV given to the first amplifier.
For the circuit shown in the Fig.Q2B, sketch the output characteristics and mark the operating point. Assume $\beta=100$, Silicon transistor.

questions.markdown: In a bridge rectifier circuit, if the peak voltage appearing across the secondary winding of the transformer is 10V, find the (i) DC output Voltage (ii) RMS output voltage. Assume ideal diodes.
Write the truth table of full adder and obtain the simplified expressions for sum and carry using k-map. Realize using Basic gates (AND, OR, NOT).
Realize the equation $V_{OUT}=-3V_1-2V_2-0.5V_3$ using an OP-AMP, where $V_1$, $V_2$, $V_3$ are the input voltages and $V_{OUT}$ is the output voltage. Draw the circuit diagram.

questions.markdown: A logic circuit that has 3-inputs A, B, C which provides output '1' when two or more input variables are '1'. Obtain a simplified expression for the system using K-map and implement using-only NAND gates.
Generate $(7, 4)$ Hamming code for the binary data '1011'. Also, write the gray code representation for the same binary data '1011'.

An audio signal $10\sin(2\pi 500t)$ is used to amplitude modulate a carrier of $50\sin(2\pi 10^5 t)$. Calculate the (i) Modulation index (ii) Bandwidth required for transmission (iii) Side band frequencies (iv) Side band amplitudes.

Given a FM equation, $V_{FM}(t)=5\cos[2\pi 10^8 t + 5\sin(2\pi 10^4 t)]$, Calculate (i) Carrier signal frequency and Modulating signal frequency (ii) Frequency deviation (iii) Bandwidth using Carson's rule.
Sketch the ASK, FSK and PSK signals for the 6-bit binary data '101101'.
